root_causes.root_cause: _is_garbled_blob checks PUA (U+E000-U+F8FF) at 3% threshold but has NO check for Arabic Presentation Forms (U+FB50-FDFF, U+FE70-FEFF). These are positional glyph variants that indicate font-encoded garble, but they are valid Unicode points outside PUA range. _infer_script (line 962) counts them as Arabic (lines 971-976), reinforcing the false-negative. Documents with 93%+ presentation forms pass all garble checks and store PASS verdict.
root_causes.code_path: helpers.py::_is_garbled_blob (line 879-881 PUA check) -> _infer_script (line 971-976 counts FB50-FEFF as Arabic) -> _tree_is_garbled -> validate_tree -> classify_verdict stores PASS
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add a presentation-forms ratio check in _is_garbled_blob, after the PUA check. Count chars in U+FB50-FDFF and U+FE70-FEFF ranges; if ratio exceeds threshold (e.g., 0.50 of total Arabic chars), return True. This catches documents where text extraction emitted positional glyph forms instead of logical Arabic Unicode.

root_causes.root_cause: _tree_is_rtl_reversed (RFC-027 D3) compares _arabic_readability_score for forward vs get_display() reversed text, but _arabic_readability_score only checks 14 _AR_COMMON_WORDS and _AR_DEFINITE_RE matches. For specialized vocabulary (governance, data policy) where sampled lines contain no common words and word-level reversal preserves definite-article pattern, both orig_total and disp_total are 0 or equal, so disp_total > orig_total is False and reversal goes undetected. validate_tree returns (True, '') and stored verdict is PASS with empty reason.
root_causes.code_path: helpers.py::_tree_is_rtl_reversed (line 1047-1089) -> _arabic_readability_score (converters.py line 1341-1348) -> _AR_COMMON_WORDS (14 words) -> validate_tree (line 1129) returns True -> classify_verdict stores PASS
root_causes.suggested_fix: Expand _arabic_readability_score with additional signals: (1) add governance/legal domain words to _AR_COMMON_WORDS (حوكمة, بيانات, سياسة, إدارة, تنظيم, قرار, etc.); (2) add a character-level reversal check -- reversed Arabic characters produce morphologically invalid sequences (final-form chars at word start, initial-form at word end) that can be detected without vocabulary dependence; (3) consider bigram frequency analysis as a vocabulary-independent readability signal.

root_causes.root_cause: Arabic PDFs with custom font encoding (PUA glyphs in U+E000-F8FF) or scanned-only content defeat both text-layer extraction and OCR fallback. For القرار التنظيمي: the pre-conversion garble probe (D3a, client.py line 721) detects garble but PRE_GARBLE_FORCE_OCR_ENABLED defaults to false, so OCR is deferred to Fix-3 retry. The Fix-3 retry fires but Tesseract OCR on custom-font PUA PDFs produces near-zero output (123 chars). For وارد 597: OCR fires but produces only numeric junk (barcode/watermark noise) with 0 Arabic chars -- the garble gate NOW correctly catches this (MARGINAL garbling(ratio=1.00)) but no further recovery path exists.
root_causes.code_path: client.py line 721-741 (D3a probe) -> PRE_GARBLE_FORCE_OCR_ENABLED=false -> Fix-3 retry (line 984) -> converters.py tesseract_ocr_pdf_pages -> near-zero/junk output
root_causes.suggested_fix: Two-pronged: (1) For PUA-encoded PDFs (القرار التنظيمي): when OCR escalation also fails (output < LOW_CONTENT_OCR_CHAR_FLOOR after retry), attempt rasterize-then-OCR as a final fallback -- bypass the corrupt text layer entirely by rendering pages as images and OCR-ing the raster. (2) For scanned PDFs producing only numeric junk (وارد 597): add post-OCR Arabic content validation -- if OCR output has 0 Arabic chars on a document with Arabic filename, flag as extraction failure rather than storing junk. Both require per-doc investigation to validate feasibility.
